title: Which AI model is best for GameDev RN ?
author: ra13it
selftext: Please i need tour honest thoughts and suggestions 🥹

comments.author: sirpalee
comments.body: AI model for what? Coding? Voice? Music? Models? Textures? Concept art? Scene composition? Writing?

replies.author: ra13it
replies.body: I put it on the tittle tho, game development

replies.author: speederaser
replies.body:
That's a hella wide category mate. 


What style of game? Do you have a code language preference? Engine preference? Budget? Multiplayer? 


What level of experience do you have? 


For example if you are totally new I would say GDev, but if you are experienced and have tons of money, I would say Sonnet + Unreal.

replies.author: ra13it
replies.body: ah yes, im sorry mate..  im still new at theses kinda thing.. i kinda just want to vibe code it all along. I do have some experience with unreal, and i just bought claude code and started to learn things.. do you have any suggestions or could you share your recommendation workflow for gamedev with ai? That’ll be super helpfull

replies.author: speederaser
replies.body:
All I can say is you are on the right track. 


Just to share my examples, I built my last game using Grok and Sonnet through Roo Code in pure JavaScript as a web app. Small charades / heads up game. My current game is a pixel strategy game. Built in Gdevelop with P2P multiplayer. Gdev also has an AI to write JavaScript. I also made another AI from scratch that can play any board games against you after you teach it how to play. That was python and tkinter. Mostly written with Aider using GPT and some Sonnet. Then I generate a lot of art with many other models. 


There's a lot of options depending on what you are building.

replies.author: sirpalee
replies.body: There are separate models for separate tasks. Claude Code might be the best experience for coding RN, but it can't do image generation or model generation. And even the model recommendations are changing rapidly.

comments.author: Orinks
comments.body: I'm looking for good tools to make sound and music assets.

replies.author: speederaser
replies.body: Keep in mind there are a lot of free assets already available. Generating sound is hard and finding a free sound is easy.

replies.author: Plufit0_
replies.body:
Disagree, had to listen to a lot of free music for my game and I was never able to find something I was midly okay with.  
With Suno I was able to get something okay in 10 minutes while having a lot of fun in the process

replies.author: speederaser
replies.body: Sign me up. I haven't found an AI that makes anything good yet, but I'll be happy to try one that works.

replies.author: Plufit0_
replies.body: Suno very easily reaches acceptable, I don't think it can reach good

comments.author: icekiller333
comments.body: Ive been having a blast with sonnet 4.5 directly in vs code with the Claude Vode extension. I have both an api key and a pro account, but mostly stick to the pro account connection unless I run out of usage and really feel like paying a few extra bucks to complete something
